title: Lift the pure indicators into libs/indicators
description: Create the npm workspace package @trade-automation/indicators (libs/indicators, same package.json/tsconfig/jest layout as libs/contracts, built to dist/, browser-safe: no Node imports). Move computeAtr, computeVwapBand, computeRange, computePreviousHourLH and computeFvg (with their result types) out of apps/signal-server/src/strategy-engine/strategies/vwap-band-reversal/indicators/ into the package without changing their bodies; move their existing specs with them; make the vwap-band-reversal plug-in import from the package and delete the server copies. Design: architecture/backtest-app-system-design.md §2.1 (D1). Done when: the package builds and its specs pass; the server builds and its full jest suite is green with no behaviour change in the plug-in; `npm run build` at the repo root builds contracts, indicators, then the server.

title: Scaffold libs/replay-core with the lifted Resampler and the replay calendar
description: Create @trade-automation/replay-core (libs/replay-core, package layout as libs/contracts, browser-safe, depends only on contracts). (1) Move the Resampler class from apps/signal-server/src/market-data/resampler.ts into src/resample/ unchanged, with its specs; resampler.service.ts and every other server importer switch to the package. (2) Add foldOneMinute(bars1m, tf, upToMs) returning {closed: Candle[], forming: Candle|null} built on the Resampler (forming = the bar containing upToMs, or null when upToMs is exactly on a boundary). (3) Add src/calendar/: barCloseAfter(cursorMs, tf), isWeekend(ms) for the UTC interval [Sat 00:00, Mon 00:00), mondayAfter(ms), and nextCursor(cursorMs, tf, skipWeekends, nextDataAt, periodToMs) exactly as specified in architecture/backtest-app-system-design.md §5.2. Done when: specs cover a tf boundary, a mid-bar cursor producing a forming bar, weekend skipping on and off, an empty stretch that is jumped, the tape-exhausted case returning periodToMs, and a cursor already at periodToMs; the server suite stays green after the move.

title: Extend libs/contracts with the auth and backtest wire contracts
description: Additive changes to libs/contracts: (1) instrument.ts: optional `sessionCurrency` (defaults to quoteCurrency at parse time) and set `sessionCurrency: USD` on the binance entries in apps/signal-server/config/instruments.yaml (D11). (2) New auth.ts: LoginRequest, UserSchema {id, email, role}, InviteInfo, AcceptInviteRequest, admin invite/user list shapes. (3) New backtest.ts: SessionLayoutSchema (candle panels only, 1..4, signals ignored), CreateSessionRequest, PatchSessionRequest, Session, SessionSummary, SessionDetail, Costs, Order (every column of the orders table in camelCase), OrderModification, FillEvent, PlaceOrderRequest, CancelRequest, CloseRequest, ModifyOrderRequest, AdvanceRequest, AdvanceResult, SessionStats (fields listed in architecture/backtest-app-system-design.md §8), ReplayHistoryQuery/Response, AheadQuery/Response (compact [openTime,o,h,l,c,v] tuples), ScreenshotKind, BacktestInstrument (with coverage), and the error envelope {error:{code,message}} with the code enum from §7. Every request schema has zod validation strict enough for ZodValidationPipe (numbers coerced from query strings, ms as non-negative ints). Done when: the package builds, schemas have spec coverage for one valid and one invalid example each, and existing consumers compile unchanged.

title: Add the PostgreSQL adapter, migration runner and initial schema to signal-server
description: First database in the repo. Add apps/signal-server/src/db/: db.port.ts (Db interface: query<T>(sql, params), transaction<T>(fn(tx)) where tx exposes the same query), pg/pg-database.ts (pg Pool implementation, numeric columns parsed to number at the boundary), migration-runner.ts using postgrator (driver pg, migrationPattern migrations/*, schemaTable schema_migrations) wrapped in pg_advisory_lock(hashtext('bt-migrate')), migrate.ts CLI entry (`npm run migrate`), and db.module.ts exporting the DB token; the module is enabled only when DATABASE_URL is set (no default) and runs migrations at boot when DB_MIGRATE_ON_BOOT is true (default). Write apps/signal-server/migrations/001.do.init.sql / 001.undo.init.sql with the full schema from architecture/backtest-app-system-design.md §3 (users, invites, auth_sessions, backtest_sessions, orders, order_modifications, screenshots, backtest_ops, indexes, checks, cascades). Add DATABASE_URL, DB_MIGRATE_ON_BOOT, ADMIN_EMAIL, ADMIN_PASSWORD, APP_BASE_URL, SESSION_COOKIE_SECURE, SCREENSHOT_STORE, SCREENSHOT_MAX_WIDTH_PX to env.schema.ts. Add a postgres:16-alpine service to apps/signal-server/docker-compose.yml (podman-compose compatible) and document the one-database-per-slot convention (§4) in apps/signal-server/README.md. Done when: with a local Postgres the server boots, applies 001, and boots again as a no-op; without DATABASE_URL the server boots exactly as before; a jest test using a real DATABASE_URL (skipped when unset) proves transaction rollback and cascade delete session -> orders -> modifications.

title: Implement the fill engine, costs, sizing and floating mark in libs/replay-core
description: Add src/costs/, src/sizing/, src/fill/, src/mark/ to libs/replay-core implementing architecture/backtest-app-system-design.md §6 exactly: marketFillPrice/stopExitPrice/fee/spreadCost with Costs {enabled, commissionPct, spread} where spread is the full width and half-spread is paid adversely; positionSize(balance, riskPct, plannedEntry, sl) -> {qty, riskAmount}; evaluateOrder(order, path, costs) -> FillEvent[] walking a 1m path (limit fill at the level, stop exit with gap-through at open, TP at the level with gap-through, SL-first when both touch in one candle, fill-then-exit on the same candle, manual/end-of-session market exit helper), plus walkBarsPessimistic for the no-1m fallback flagged resolution 'pessimistic-bar'; computeTradeResult(order, exitEvent) -> {commissionCcy, spreadCostCcy, pnlCcy, pnlR}; computeMae(order, path) -> {maePrice, maeR}; floatingPnl(position, lastClose, costs) and openRisk(positions). All functions pure over contracts types. Done when: a fixture-driven spec suite covers every row of the §6 table for long and short, costs on and off, the pessimistic fallback, gap-through, MAE, floating PnL, and sizing; the suite is the reference the server and client tests reuse.

title: Implement session statistics in libs/replay-core
description: Add src/stats/computeStats(closedOrders, initialBalance, periodFromMs) -> SessionStats per architecture/backtest-app-system-design.md §8: counts and win rate, pnl in currency and R, gross profit/loss and profit factor (null with no losses), the stepped equity curve (one point per close, seeded at period start) with max drawdown in currency, R and % of peak, average win/loss, expectancy in R, MAE average and worst, pessimistic and end-of-session counts, per-instrument and per-side breakdowns. Also export the subset written to the backtest_sessions aggregate columns. Done when: specs cover an empty session, a single trade, a drawdown that is recovered (drawdown measured on the stepped curve, not intrabar), a session with only wins (profit factor null), and a mixed-instrument session; results are deterministic and independent of input order.

title: Add cookie-session authentication, invites and the global guard to signal-server
description: Implement apps/signal-server/src/auth/ per architecture/backtest-app-system-design.md §7.1 and D7: user/invite/auth-session repository ports with pg implementations; PasswordHasher on Node crypto.scrypt (N=2^15, r=8, p=1, 16-byte salt, self-describing hash string); SessionCookie (name bt_session, HttpOnly, SameSite=Lax, Path=/, Secure from SESSION_COOKIE_SECURE, 30-day sliding expiry, DB row keyed by sha256 of the cookie value); AdminBootstrap upserting the admin from ADMIN_EMAIL/ADMIN_PASSWORD at boot; in-memory login throttle (10 failures / email / 15 min -> 429). Endpoints: POST /api/auth/login, POST /api/auth/logout, GET /api/auth/me, GET /api/auth/invites/:token, POST /api/auth/invites/:token/accept (single-use via the conditional UPDATE, 7-day expiry, password >= 10 chars). Register AuthGuard as APP_GUARD with @Public() on login/invite/health/observability-metrics and @CurrentUser(); every existing REST route becomes authenticated; LiveGateway.handleConnection validates the cookie when the DB module is enabled and keeps the WS_SHARED_TOKEN check otherwise; main.ts CORS gains credentials: true. Without DATABASE_URL the auth routes return 503 and the guard is a pass-through (documented dev/mock behaviour). Done when: jest covers hashing round-trip, invite accept exactly once under concurrent calls, expiry, cookie sliding refresh, guard on a protected and a public route; a manual curl flow login -> me -> logout works against a local DB.

title: Add the admin endpoints for users and invites
description: Add apps/signal-server/src/api/rest/admin.controller.ts behind an admin-role check on top of AuthGuard: GET /api/admin/users (id, email, role, createdAt, disabledAt only - no session or journal data, decision 30), POST /api/admin/users/:id/disable and /enable (disable deletes that user's auth_sessions), POST /api/admin/invites {email?} returning {id, url, expiresAt} with url = APP_BASE_URL + '/invite/' + token and the token shown exactly once, GET /api/admin/invites (never the token), DELETE /api/admin/invites/:id (unused only, 409 INVITE_USED). Done when: jest covers the role check (403 for a user), single-show of the token, and revoke of a used invite; the admin cannot reach any /api/backtest/sessions of another user through any admin route.

title: Add the router, login and invite-accept pages and the auth guard to chart-client
description: Introduce routing per architecture/backtest-app-system-design.md §2.3: provideRouter in app.config.ts, App renders <router-outlet>, routes /login, /invite/:token, /terminal (the unchanged TerminalShellComponent), placeholder /sessions (default redirect) and /admin/users, all non-public routes behind an auth guard that probes GET /api/auth/me once. Add core/auth/auth.service.ts (user signal, login, logout, acceptInvite) and make RestClient send credentials: 'include' and treat 401 as 'go to /login'. Build features/auth/login and features/auth/invite-accept (three files each, OnPush, signal inputs) in the existing dark-terminal palette; the invite page shows the invite's state (unknown/used/expired) and ends in a set-password form that logs the user in. Extend apps/chart-client/mock-server with an in-memory auth stub (a fixed admin, invite create/accept, cookie) so the client runs against :4300 without a database. Done when: ng test is green (report the count), the terminal is reachable only after login, logout returns to /login, and the e2e suite still passes with the mock auth stub (an auto-login in the e2e fixtures is acceptable).

title: Build the admin users and invites page in chart-client
description: features/admin/users.component at /admin/users, behind an admin guard on top of the auth guard: table of users (email, role, created, disabled) with disable/enable; invites list with create (optional email) showing the one-time invite URL with a copy button, and revoke for unused invites. Uses the endpoints of T-008 through core/api. No session or journal information of any user is shown anywhere on this page (decision 30). Done when: ng test is green (count reported), the page is inaccessible to a non-admin (redirect to /sessions), and the flow create invite -> open the URL in a private window -> accept -> the new user appears in the list works against the real server.

title: Add CandleStore.coverage and GET /api/backtest/instruments
description: Extend the CandleStore port (apps/signal-server/src/storage/candle-store.port.ts) with coverage(instrument, tf) -> {from, to} | null (earliest and latest openTime held) and implement it in FileCandleStore (directory listing of date= files, reading only the first and last) and S3CandleStore (ListObjectsV2 on the tf prefix, first and last key). Add GET /api/backtest/instruments returning every configured instrument with id, displayName, assetClass, pricePrecision, sessionCurrency and its 1m coverage (null when nothing is stored), so the create-session form reflects what is actually on disk (decisions 16, 5b). Done when: both store implementations have specs for empty, single-day and multi-day coverage; the endpoint is authenticated and returns coverage for binance:BTCUSDT against the real data directory.

title: Add the derive-timeframes job that persists 5m/15m/1h/4h/1d bars from stored 1m
description: Add apps/signal-server/src/jobs/derive-timeframes.ts (CLI: node dist/jobs/derive-timeframes.js [--instrument <id>] [--from <iso>]): for each configured instrument with 1m coverage, stream 1m from CandleStore in ascending order through the replay-core Resampler and upsert every closed derived bar with source 'resampled', in day-sized batches, skipping ranges already present at the target tf unless --force. Idempotent; no venue calls; logs per-instrument counts. Add an npm script. Design: architecture/backtest-app-system-design.md §10. Done when: a spec proves that running twice is a no-op and that a partial-day 1m tail does not emit a closed bar; running it against the real data directory fills tf=5m/15m/1h/4h for binance:BTCUSDT across the full 1m range (report the day counts before and after).

title: Add backtest session persistence and the session endpoints
description: Add apps/signal-server/src/backtest/ (BacktestModule): session.repository.port.ts + pg implementation over the backtest_sessions table; SessionService with session-validation.ts (SessionLayoutSchema, <= 4 candle panels, every panel instrument available with 1m coverage intersecting the period, one sessionCurrency across panels, period sanity); endpoints per architecture/backtest-app-system-design.md §7.2: POST /api/backtest/sessions (cursor = periodFromMs, balance = initialBalance, layout stored as the session's own copy, skipWeekends default true, notionalWarnMultiple default 5), GET /api/backtest/sessions (summaries with aggregate columns), GET /api/backtest/sessions/:id (session + open orders placeholder + stored stats), PATCH /api/backtest/sessions/:id {name?, timeframe?} (layout patch is T-029), DELETE /api/backtest/sessions/:id (row delete; the S3 prefix step is added by T-025). Every query scoped to the cookie user; another user's session is 404. Error codes as listed in §7.2. Done when: jest covers each validation code, tenancy isolation between two users, and the cascade on delete; a manual flow create -> list -> get -> patch timeframe -> delete works against a local DB.

title: Serve replay candles: history behind the cursor with the forming bar, and 1m ahead pages
description: Add ReplayHistoryService and ReplayAheadService plus apps/signal-server/src/api/rest/backtest/candles.controller.ts per architecture/backtest-app-system-design.md §7.2 and §5.3. GET /api/backtest/sessions/:id/candles?panelId&timeframe&before&limit returns the last `limit` closed bars of that timeframe with openTime + tfMs <= before, read from the store's persisted derived tf when present and otherwise folded on demand from 1m with replay-core foldOneMinute (warn-logged), plus `forming` built from 1m in [floor(before/tfMs)*tfMs, before) or null on a boundary; before > cursor_ms is 422 FUTURE_REQUESTED; panelId must exist in the session layout. GET /api/backtest/sessions/:id/candles/ahead?panelId&fromMs&limit(<=5000) returns 1m candles with openTime >= fromMs as compact tuples, clamped to period_to_ms, with endOfTape true when the store has nothing further inside the period. Done when: jest covers the forming bar at a mid-bar cursor and its absence on a boundary, the fallback fold, the future guard, the period clamp and endOfTape; against the real BTCUSDT data a 1d history of 300 bars at a 2021 cursor returns in under 500 ms after T-012 has run.

title: Add order persistence and the place, cancel, manual-close, list and get order endpoints
description: Add order.repository.port.ts (+pg) over orders and order_modifications, ops.repository.port.ts (+pg) over backtest_ops for opId idempotency (D9: a repeated opId replays the stored response), and OrderService with endpoints per architecture/backtest-app-system-design.md §7.2: POST /api/backtest/sessions/:id/orders (validates cursorMs == cursor_ms -> 409 CURSOR_MISMATCH, side/type/level checks -> 422 codes, computes qty and riskAmount with replay-core positionSize from the current balance; a market order fills immediately at lastClose +/- half-spread via replay-core with entry_time_ms = openTime of the last revealed 1m candle; a limit order is pending; assigns seq), POST .../orders/:orderId/cancel (pending only), POST .../orders/:orderId/close (open only; market exit at the cursor, close_reason manual, computes costs/pnl/R/MAE with replay-core, updates balance and the aggregate columns with computeStats in one transaction), GET .../orders?status=, GET .../orders/:orderId (with modifications; screenshots object empty until T-025). GET /api/backtest/sessions/:id now returns openOrders. All scoped to the cookie user. Done when: jest covers each error code, idempotent replay of a duplicated opId, a market fill's price with costs on and off, a manual close updating balance and aggregates transactionally, and seq ordering.

title: Introduce the PanelSource boundary so the chart kit renders from any feed
description: Client refactor with no behaviour change: define features/panel-grid/panel-source.ts (PanelSource: panel, candles/overlays/indicatorPoints/indicatorSpecs signals, loadOlder()) as in architecture/backtest-app-system-design.md §2.3 (D2); make PanelFeed satisfy it (adapter or direct implementation) and change ChartPanelComponent, PanelGridComponent and LayoutFeedService to depend on PanelSource rather than on PanelFeed's concrete class; ChartComponent is untouched. Also add a `crosshairPrice` signal next to the existing `crosshairTime` on ChartComponent (needed by the position tool). Done when: every existing ng test and e2e passes unchanged (report the count), and a spec instantiates ChartPanelComponent with a stub PanelSource that is not a PanelFeed.

title: Add the advance endpoint: walk the 1m path, close trades, update balance and aggregates, end the session
description: Add AdvanceService and POST /api/backtest/sessions/:id/advance {opId, toCursorMs} implementing architecture/backtest-app-system-design.md §5.5 step by step: FOR UPDATE on the session, 409 CURSOR_BACKWARDS / SESSION_COMPLETE, clamp to period_to_ms, idempotent via backtest_ops; for every instrument with pending/open orders read the 1m path for (cursor_ms, toCursorMs) from CandleStore, fall back to the session-timeframe bars with walkBarsPessimistic and fill_resolution 'pessimistic-bar' when no 1m exists, evaluate with replay-core evaluateOrder chronologically, write fills and exits (costs, pnl, R, MAE from the 1m path between entry and exit), apply balance changes in exit-time order, recompute the aggregate columns with computeStats; at toCursorMs == period_to_ms force-close open positions as market exits with close_reason end-of-session, cancel pending orders, set status complete; one transaction; respond with {cursorMs, status, balance, events, orders touched, stats}. Done when: jest (against a fixture 1m tape in the file store) covers a limit fill then stop in a later span, SL and TP in one candle resolving stop-first, gap-through, the pessimistic fallback flag, a coalesced multi-bar span with two exits, end-of-session force close and cancellation, idempotent replay, and that an advance with no orders only moves the cursor.

title: Add GET /api/backtest/sessions/:id/stats with full recompute and drift detection
description: StatsService + endpoint returning {computed, stored, drift}: `computed` is replay-core computeStats over every closed order of the session read from the orders table; `stored` is the aggregate subset from the session row; `drift` is true when any stored field differs from the recomputed value beyond 1e-8 (decision 38). Done when: jest shows drift false after T-017's flows and drift true after an aggregate column is tampered with directly in the DB; the endpoint is scoped to the cookie user.

title: Build the sessions list and create-session screens
description: features/sessions/session-list (route /sessions: name, instruments, period, timeframe, status, balance, pnl in currency and R, trades count from the summaries; open, and delete with a confirm that states orders and screenshots are removed) and features/sessions/session-create (route /sessions/new): instrument picker fed by GET /api/backtest/instruments showing only instruments with 1m coverage and grouped by sessionCurrency with mixing rejected client-side (server rejects too); layout presets from GET /api/layouts with metric panels stripped and > 4 panels refused; period bounded by the intersection of the chosen instruments' coverage; timeframe; initial balance; default risk % (default 1); costs (enabled, commission %, spread) ; skip weekends (default on); notional warning multiple (default 5). Pure validation in session-form.validation.ts with specs. core/api/backtest.client.ts gets the typed fetchers. Extend the mock-server with in-memory backtest instruments/sessions routes. Done when: ng test is green (count reported), a session can be created and deleted against the real server, and a mixed-currency selection cannot be submitted.

title: Build the replay workspace: cursor, 1m ahead cache, stepping and timeframe switching
description: Route /sessions/:id: features/backtest/workspace (shell: replay-toolbar with session name, cursor time in UTC, timeframe picker, step button, balance; the panel grid rendered through ReplayPanelSource per panel via T-016's PanelSource). core/replay/: ReplayEngine (framework-free; step() = replay-core nextCursor over the caches; pops revealed 1m candles per panel and folds them with foldOneMinute into the panel's timeframe series, appending closed bars and replacing the forming bar), AheadCache per panel (compact tuples; target/refill sizes from architecture/backtest-app-system-design.md §5.3; background refill through GET .../candles/ahead in 5000-candle pages; a step that outruns the cache blocks the key and shows a loading state; endOfTape handling), history load through GET .../candles?before=cursor with the forming bar, loadOlder pagination, timeframe switch that keeps the cursor and re-fetches history at the new tf so the current bar appears partially formed and queues PATCH {timeframe}. Hotkey: ArrowRight steps; [ and ] switch tf; all ignored while typing. No orders yet; the server is not told about advances yet (T-021) except the timeframe patch. Every pure helper in its own file with a spec (cache sizing, fold-on-step, next-data lookup). Done when: ng test is green (count reported); against the real server a BTCUSDT session on 5m steps smoothly across a weekend-skip and an empty stretch, switching to 1h mid-bar shows a forming bar at the same cursor, and the cache refills without a visible stall.

title: Add the AdvanceQueue: persist every step to the server and reconcile its events
description: core/replay/advance-queue.ts: a single serialised promise chain of mutations {advance, place, cancel, close, modify}, each with a client uuid opId, retried with backoff on network errors, never reordering an order op relative to the advances around it, and coalescing consecutive queued advances into one with the latest toCursorMs (architecture/backtest-app-system-design.md §5.5). On every response the client replaces its local order/portfolio state for the returned orders, applies balance/status/stats, and on a session becoming complete locks the workspace (toolbar shows completed). A preview/server mismatch (T-023 will add previews) is logged and surfaced as a one-line resynced toast. 409 CURSOR_BACKWARDS/CURSOR_MISMATCH reloads the session from the server (second-tab guard). Done when: specs cover coalescing, ordering of an order op between advances, retry, and reconcile; against the real server a reload of the workspace resumes at the persisted cursor and stepping to the period end marks the session complete.

title: Build the position tool: primitive, pointer controller, per-panel store and hotkeys
description: Implement architecture/backtest-app-system-design.md §9.1. features/chart/overlay/position-tool.primitive.ts (a second ISeriesPrimitive drawing PositionToolState[]: entry/SL/TP rays with labels price, distance, R multiple, qty; translucent risk and reward rects in the palette's #ef5350 / #26a69a; handles on drafts, SL/TP handles only on positions, active tool drawn brighter), position-tool.geometry.ts (pure label and hit-test helpers with specs), position-tool.controller.ts (container pointerdown/move/up/cancel; hit-test picks and activates a tool and starts a handle or whole-tool drag with pointer capture and chart scroll/scale disabled during the drag; price snapped to pricePrecision; dragging a draft's entry across the last close flips market/limit; emits changes). ChartComponent gains inputs positionTools, positionToolsEnabled and output positionToolChange, staying under the 250-line ceiling by delegating. core/replay/position-tools.store.ts per panel: B/S create a draft at the crosshair price (or last close) with SL at 0.5 % of price on the adverse side and TP at 2R, the new draft becomes active; last created or clicked is active; Esc removes the active draft; Enter with no active draft shows the hint toast and does nothing. Drafts do not yet place orders (T-023). Done when: ng test is green (count reported); manually, two drafts on one panel can be created, dragged by their handles without the chart panning, activated by click, and removed with Esc; ShapesPrimitive is unchanged.

title: Place, preview and manage orders from the workspace
description: Wire the trading loop: Enter on an active draft builds PlaceOrderRequest from the tool (side, market/limit, level, SL, optional TP, risk % from the order panel defaulting to the session's) and pushes a place op through the AdvanceQueue; on 201 the draft is consumed into a pending or position drawing carrying orderId; features/backtest/order-panel shows the active draft's derived size, risk amount, R multiple and the notional warning when qty * entry > balance * notionalWarnMultiple; features/backtest/positions-panel lists pending and open orders with floating PnL and open risk from replay-core mark (marked at the last revealed 1m close adjusted for spread, recomputed on every step), total open risk in the toolbar, cancel for pending and close-at-market for open (ops through the queue). core/replay/portfolio.store.ts previews fills on each step by running replay-core evaluateOrder over the popped 1m candles so the drawing flips pending -> position -> gone before the server response, then reconciles with the response (T-021). Done when: specs cover the preview against the replay-core fixtures and the notional warning; against the real server the flow draft -> Enter -> limit pending -> filled on a later step -> stopped out shows the same prices client-side and in the server's order row, and Enter without a draft never creates an order.

title: Build the trade journal and the basic statistics summary in the workspace
description: features/backtest/journal: a table of the session's orders from GET .../orders ordered by seq (instrument, side, type, placed, entry, exit, close reason, qty, costs, pnl in currency and R, MAE in R, a visible flag for fill_resolution pessimistic-bar and for end-of-session closes), refreshed from AdvanceQueue responses; features/backtest/stats-summary from GET .../stats: trades, win rate, pnl currency and R, profit factor, max drawdown currency/R/%, average win and loss, with a 'stored aggregates differ' notice when drift is true. Both live in the workspace's side/bottom area and are read-only. Done when: ng test is green (count reported) and after a handful of trades the journal rows equal the server's orders and the summary equals GET .../stats.

title: Add the ScreenshotStore, screenshot endpoints and S3-first session deletion
description: Add storage/screenshot-store.port.ts (put, get, deleteByPrefix) with FileScreenshotStore under FILE_STORE_ROOT and S3ScreenshotStore, selected by SCREENSHOT_STORE (defaults to CANDLE_STORE's mode); key scheme backtest/screenshots/user=<userId>/session=<sessionId>/order=<orderId>/<kind>.png (architecture/backtest-app-system-design.md §9.2). Endpoints: PUT /api/backtest/sessions/:id/orders/:orderId/screenshots/:kind (image/png body <= 2 MB, written once -> 409 SCREENSHOT_EXISTS, records a screenshots row with dimensions and bytes) and GET of the same path streaming the PNG with a private long-lived cache header. DELETE session now calls deleteByPrefix for the session prefix before deleting the row and aborts if the store call fails. GET .../orders/:orderId returns screenshot URLs. Done when: jest (aws-sdk-client-mock for S3, tmp dir for file) covers put/get/delete-by-prefix for both stores, the write-once rule, and that a failed prefix delete leaves the session in place.

title: Capture and upload the entry and exit screenshots from the client
description: core/replay/capture-chart.ts: takeScreenshot() on the owning panel's chart, downscaled on an offscreen canvas to at most SCREENSHOT width 1280 px keeping aspect, PNG blob; core/replay/screenshot-upload.queue.ts: a root service that uploads with retry/backoff and survives route changes. Capture moments per architecture/backtest-app-system-design.md §9.2: entry synchronously in the Enter handler before the place request; exit in the AdvanceQueue response handler for every exit event in a response (a coalesced response with several exits yields several captures, including manual and end-of-session closes). The journal and trade detail show a placeholder until the row exists. Done when: specs cover the downscale bound and the retry; manually, a session with a limit fill, a stop-out during fast stepping and a manual close ends with two screenshots on each of those orders, visible through the GET endpoint.

title: Add EMA, SMA, RSI, MACD, Bollinger and Stochastic to libs/indicators
description: Pure functions in libs/indicators, each (bars, params) -> IndicatorSeries keyed by output name and aligned to bar openTime: ema(length), sma(length), rsi(length, Wilder smoothing), macd(fast, slow, signal) -> macd/signal/hist, bollinger(length, stdDevs) -> upper/middle/lower (population std dev), stochastic(kLength, dLength, smoothing) -> k/d. Also export an IndicatorCatalog entry per indicator (id, display name, params with defaults, output series with pane hint: overlay vs separate) that the client picker can render without hardcoding. Done when: each function has a spec against hand-computed values on a short fixture and a warm-up test (undefined before enough bars); the package stays browser-safe.

title: Add the indicator catalogue to backtest panels, computed on the client
description: features/backtest/indicator-picker: per panel, add/remove indicators from the libs/indicators catalogue (VWAP, ATR, range, previous-hour H/L, FVG, EMA, SMA, RSI, MACD, Bollinger, Stochastic) with parameter editing; ReplayPanelSource computes the series with the lifted pure functions over the panel's current timeframe series (closed bars plus the forming bar) on every step and timeframe switch, and feeds them to the existing IndicatorLayer via indicatorPoints/indicatorSpecs (decision 11 - no server call); the chosen indicators and params are persisted inside the session's layout copy (panel.indicators) through PATCH {layout} and restored on reopen. Position-tool drafts now default SL to 1 x ATR(14) of the panel's timeframe when available (fallback 0.5 %). Done when: ng test is green (count reported); overlays and separate-pane indicators render, survive a timeframe switch and a reload, and disappear when removed.

title: Allow editing the layout inside a session
description: Server: PATCH /api/backtest/sessions/:id accepts {layout} validated with the same rules as creation (<= 4 candle panels, instruments with coverage intersecting the period, one sessionCurrency equal to the session's), 409 SESSION_COMPLETE on a complete session, and returns the updated session; SessionLayoutSchema gains an optional per-panel `indicators` array (id, params) carried opaquely. Client: features/backtest/layout-editor in the workspace to add, remove and reorder panels; a newly added panel loads history at the current cursor and gets its own ahead cache; removing a panel with pending or open orders is refused with a message. Done when: jest covers the server validation and the complete-session guard; ng test is green (count reported); a panel added mid-session shows the right bars at the cursor and the change survives a reload.

title: Build the trade detail page with show-on-chart in view-only mode
description: features/backtest/trade-detail at /sessions/:id/trades/:orderId: the order row (levels, fill prices, times, qty, risk amount, costs split into commission and spread, pnl in currency and R, MAE, close reason, resolution flag), the modification history, and the entry/exit screenshots when present (placeholder otherwise). 'Show on chart' navigates to /sessions/:id?viewAt=<entryTimeMs>&order=<orderId>; the workspace in view-only mode (architecture/backtest-app-system-design.md §9.3) loads history with before = viewAt, creates no ahead cache and no AdvanceQueue, makes ArrowRight/B/S/Enter inert with a 'read only' toolbar state, allows timeframe changes (not persisted) and indicators, and shows the trade's drawing as a position tool. Done when: ng test is green (count reported); after viewing a past trade and returning to the workspace the session's cursor is unchanged on the server.

title: Add the throttled 1m backfill job and the remaining FX instruments
description: apps/signal-server/src/jobs/backfill.ts (CLI: node dist/jobs/backfill.js --instrument <id> [--from <iso>]): instrument ids only from instruments.yaml; walks backwards from CandleStore.latestOpenTime (or forwards from --from) to the vendor floor using the existing venue adapters, upserting 1m in day batches, resumable, and finishing with derive-timeframes for that instrument. Throttle: Binance 1 request/s at limit 1500 (weight 10 each => 600 weight/min, 25 % of the 2400 budget - state this in the job's header comment and README); Capital.com 1 request/s at 720 bars, hard stop at the 2024-01-02 intraday floor. Add capitalcom:EURUSD and capitalcom:GBPUSD to instruments.yaml with sessionCurrency USD (EURCHF/GBPCHF exist with CHF). Design: architecture/backtest-app-system-design.md §10. Done when: a spec proves the throttle and resume logic with a stub adapter; the job runs for the four FX pairs and US100/US500/DXY (report coverage per instrument from GET /api/backtest/instruments afterwards).

title: Build the full statistics screen
description: features/backtest/stats-full (a tab in the workspace and reachable for complete sessions from the list): from GET .../stats render the stepped equity curve in currency and R (lightweight-charts line, palette colours), drawdown overlay, distribution of trade results in R, MAE average and worst with the count of pessimistic-resolution trades called out, and per-instrument and per-side breakdowns (trades, win rate, pnl). Captions in the UI are for the user and therefore in plain Russian (PROJECT.md 'Communicating with the user'). Done when: ng test is green (count reported) and the screen renders for an empty session, a one-trade session and a multi-instrument session without errors.

title: Move stop-loss and take-profit on pending and open orders with modification history
description: Server: PATCH /api/backtest/sessions/:id/orders/:orderId {opId, cursorMs, sl?, tp?} for pending and open orders, wrong-side checks (422), 409 for closed/cancelled or a cursor mismatch, writing one order_modifications row per changed field with the cursor time (decision 23); sl_initial and riskAmount never change (R stays anchored to the placement risk). Client: SL/TP handles on pending and position drawings become draggable through the position-tool controller; dropping a handle pushes a modify op through the AdvanceQueue and the drawing snaps to the server's returned values; the positions panel recomputes open risk from sl_current; trade detail lists the modifications. Done when: jest covers the endpoint's rules and the history rows; ng test is green (count reported); manually, moving a stop to break-even and being stopped there shows the new stop price on the order row and a modification entry at the cursor time of the move.
